headline: Leans went 14-19 on 21 Nov, and the one staked pick lost (Traore PTS 8.5: 4 points on 18 min, a minutes cut in a close game with no fouls).
Two main reasons for misses. First, minutes cut in tight games: Traore, da Silva, Sarr and Shead all played 6+ min under their average. Second, six misses by half a point. ORL@BKN went 0-7.
Status change: "minutes 5+ below avg" (after the game) is now RELIABLE at 25% vs 62%, but you can't bet on it. Price 1.50+ firmed to a 9pp gap with the CI clear of zero, so it's still a candidate.

hits_note: Darius Acuff Jr. AST 5.5 hit with 12 assists on the same cold 8-23 night his PTS missed. That cuts against the "scoring nights kill AST overs" idea: here a bad shooting night turned into a passing night.
Aaron Wiggins PTS 8.5 hit with 19 points on 34 min (+8.6). With Flemings and McCollum out, he got the minutes, which is what the absence pointed to.
Aday Mara PTS 8.5 and 6.5 hit with 22 points (11-15 shooting). OKC were 11.5-point favourites but won by only 6, so there were no blowout rests to worry about.
Anthony Davis PTS 21.5 hit with 36 points on 26 shots in the same game Sarr was cut to 20 min. Washington's frontcourt volume all went to Davis.
Peyton Watson REB 3.5 hit by 0.5, with 5 fouls and a DNP-LAST flag. It got there, but only just.
adds: Tight games hurt. ORL@BKN (margin 2) went 0-7, and the other games decided by 4 or less also went badly. Starters and stars played heavy minutes (Randle 39, Middleton 28, Vucevic 23, Graves 33), and role players lost minutes or shots. This repeats the carried-forward "close-game rotation tightening" idea. It's still a story until pattern_stats counts it.
Minutes 5+ under average was 0-6 today (Traore x2, da Silva x2, Shead, Sarr). It's now RELIABLE as a post-game cause (44 items, 33 team-games, CI +28 to +47). It explains misses but can't be bet on.
Ladder rungs moved together again. Traore, da Silva, Wagner and Kessler REB lost both rungs. That's more weight for re-running pattern_stats with each player/stat/game counted once.
REB had a bad night (only Watson hit), and the REB item gap held at +8pp. The six half-point misses are noise.
